english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a river.
Use this only when referring to an Australian creek that is large enough to be described as a river in Cantonese.

examples.english: That Australian creek only has water in the wet season; it dries up in the dry season.
examples.traditional: 澳洲嗰條河喺雨季先至有水，旱季就乾晒。
